verdict.rationale: Glama's docs and probe describe a very large catalog: 91,626 MCP servers and 23,749 remote connectors, which users can search, compare and connect to. Any registry server can be deployed behind the Gateway with credential management, and each server page provides copy-paste client configs. A community member's remark about the 'sea of existing ones' independently confirms the scale. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of actually connecting to specific third-party apps or APIs through the catalog, and documentation on how many listed integrations are maintained or verified versus community-submitted.
